tool_input.args: Figure 2 caption and image provided. Run full figure checklist (panel classification, micrograph scale bars, individual data points, error bars defined) for each panel A-G.

Figure 2 (panels A-G) as described: A - macroscopic photograph of intestines (photograph); B - H&E stained tissue sections, micrograph; C - two plots: box plot of polyp number per genotype, and 3D bar chart of polyp number by diameter and genotype; D - Kaplan-Meier survival curve plot; E - western blot panel (blot) plus bar chart (plot) of GTP-bound form quantification; F - immunohistochemistry micrographs; G - western blot/zymography panel (blot) plus bar chart (plot) of relative expression, plus additional blot panel on right (polyp diameter blot).

Panels classified: A-photograph, B-micrograph, C-plot, D-plot, E-blot+plot, F-micrograph, G-blot+plot. Check scale bars for micrograph panels B and F. Caption text: Panel F states "Scale bar, 100 μm." Panel B (H&E Swiss roll sections) has no scale bar mentioned in caption and none visible on image.

Check panels with plots: C (box plot of total polyp number per mouse across genotypes - box plot without individual points overlaid; 3D bar chart of polyp number per mouse by diameter and genotype - bar chart, no individual points, n=8-18 per genotype), D (Kaplan-Meier survival curve - not applicable type, survival curve doesn't require individual points), E (bar chart of GTP-bound form relative to Rac1/Cdc42, likely mean of replicates, no individual points shown, error bars present), G (bar chart of relative expression of Asef, pJNK1, MMP9, with error bars, no individual points shown).

Check panels with plots: C (box plot - whiskers shown, caption states "The mean numbers and sizes of intestinal polyps... n=8-18 per genotype. *P<0.05; ***P<0.001" - no explicit definition of box/whisker elements e.g. median, quartiles, min-max); 3D bar chart in C has no visible error bars; D (Kaplan-Meier curve, no error bars, not applicable); E (bar chart with small error bars on GTP-bound form graph, caption does not define error bars, e.g. SD/SEM, or n or statistics for this panel); G (bar chart with error bars for relative expression, asterisks indicating *P<0.05, caption does not state what error bars represent, e.g. SD/SEM, or n).
